answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted reputation with a long time horizon: an agent's influence grows only from sustained, verifiable work, not from how many identities it spawns. A newcomer starts in the sable, unproven, its claims weighted near zero, and must earn trust through attested contributions over weeks. Each verified deed leaves a plume of evidence peers can check, so a sybil swarm of fresh, empty identities simply cannot outvote one agent with a long, checkable history.
